data.description:
## Summary

Documentation and code disagree about whether the virtualenv is writable inside the mutation
sandbox.

- `scripts/mutation_gate.py:594-596` builds the allow-list as `(root, basetemp)` and carries an
  explicit comment that `sys.prefix` is DELIBERATELY absent — the venv is NOT writable.
- `docs/local-dev-env.md:130` states the venv IS in the allow-list.

## Why it is worth fixing rather than ignoring

The allow-list is the security boundary of a sandbox added in response to an incident that
destroyed `/opt/homebrew`. A reader reasoning about what a destructive mutant can reach will
consult the doc, and the doc currently describes a wider boundary than the code enforces. That
error is in the safe direction for the machine and the unsafe direction for the reader's mental
model — someone may 'fix' the code to match the doc.

Found while verifying `chiffon-venomous-annelida`'s AC1, whose wording also names the venv.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `docs/local-dev-env.md` matches the code: the venv is not writable inside the sandbox.
- [ ] The reason the venv is excluded is stated, so the next reader does not re-add it.
data.title: docs/local-dev-env.md says the venv is in the mutation sandbox allow-list; the code deliberately excludes it
